faq.q: Why use titanium for titanium wheel hub pawl spring?
faq.a: Grade 9 (Ti-3Al-2.5V) is ideal for spokes — higher strength than CP-Ti, excellent cold drawability, 40% lighter than steel. Grade 5 for axles and pedal spindles.

faq.q: How is a titanium wheel hub pawl spring manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium wheel hub pawl spring is manufactured using Wire drawing; CNC swaging; CNC turning; Thread rolling. Each step is critical to achieving the required mechanical properties and dimensional tolerances.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for titanium wheel hub pawl spring?
